spans.s: वैशद्य n. 1. Clearnesss, purity (lit. and fig.); 2. whiteness; 3. composure.
वैशस n. 1. Slaughter, destruction, K.S.iv.31; 2. pain, anguish, distress.
वैशस्त्र n. Government, rule.
वैशाख (I) m. 1. Name of a lunar month; 2. a churning-stick, द्रुततरकरदक्षाः क्षिप्रवैशाखशैले Sis.xi.8.
वैशाख (II) n. A particular attitude in shooting. See विशाख.
वैशाखी f. The full-moon day in the month of Vaiśākha.
वैशिक (I) m. A man who associates with courtezans.
वैशिक (II) n. Harlotry; (वैशिकी कला ‘arts generally learnt by courtezans’ Mrich.i.).
वैशिष्ट्य n. 1. Endowment with some distinguishing attribute; 2. peculiarity, particularity, प्रस्तावदेशकालादेर्वैशिष्ट्यात् K.Pr.iii.; 3. excellence.
वैशेषिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to the Vaiśeṣika doctrine.
वैशेषिक (II) n. One of the six systems of philosophy propounded by Kaṇāda; (it differs from Gautama’s system in recognizing only seven categories instead of sixteen).
वैशेषिक (III) m. A follower of the Vaiśeṣika philosophy.
वैशेषिक (I) a. (f. की) Relating to the Vaiśeṣika doctrine.
वैशेष्य n. Superiority, preeminence.
वैश्य m. A man of the third caste, (दिशत्याशु पशुभ्यश्च कृश्यादानरुचिः शुचिः । वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नः स वैश्य
इति संज्ञितः
वैश्य-वृत्ति f. the mode of life of a Vaiśya.
वैश्रवण m. 1. An epithet of Kubera, the god of wealth, विभाति य यां ललितालकायां मनोहरा वैश्रवणस्य लक्ष्मीः Bh.V.ii.10; 2. an epithet of Rāvaṇa.
वैश्रवण-आलय, -आवास m. 1. Kubera’s city; 2. the Indian fig tree.
वैश्रवण-आलय, -आवास m. 1. Kubera’s city; 2. the Indian fig tree.
वैश्रवण-उदय m. the Indian fig tree.
वैश्वदेव m. An offering made to the Viśvedevas.
वैश्वानर m. 1. An epithet of fire; 2. the digestive fire, अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः Bg.xv.14; 3. the supreme being.
वैश्वासिक a. (f. की) Trustworthy.
वैश्वासिक a. (f. की) Trustworthy.
वैषम्य n. 1. Inequality; 2. injustice; 3. misery, calamity, difficulty; 4. singleness.
वैषयिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to any object; 2. relating to an object of sense, sensual.
वैषयिक (II) m. A sensualist.
वैषयिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to any object; 2. relating to an object of sense, sensual.
वैष्टुत n. The ashes of a burnt offering.
वैष्ट्र n. 1. Air, wind; 2. heaven; 3. a world, a division of the universe.
वैष्णव (I) m. (fem. वी) Relating to Viṣṇu.
वैष्णव (II) m. One of the modern Hindu sects; (the Vaishṇavas, the Śaivas and the Śāktas are the three important modern Hindu sects).
वैष्णव (III) n. The ashes of a burnt offering.
वैष्णव-पुराण n. one of the eighteen principal Purāṇas.
वैसारिण m. A fish.
